data.title: Our hillfort volume Hradiská – Svedkovia dávnych čias is out!
data.excerpt: Our edited volume Hradiská – Svedkovia dávnych čias (Hillforts – Witnesses of Ancient Times) appeared at the end of December in a print run of 500 copies, and only about 250 of them are left. Its articles were written by renowned archaeologists and the volume also passed through the hands of two reviewers.

children.text: Our volume “Hradiská – Svedkovia dávnych čias” (Hillforts – Witnesses of Ancient Times) is out. It appeared at the end of December in a print run of 500 copies, and we already have only about 250 of them left. As the attached table of contents shows, the articles were written by renowned archaeologists, and the volume also has two reviewers, which raises its scholarly standard.
If you are interested in this work, do not hesitate and order it as soon as possible at the address:
. By buying the volume you will support us in our further work in the future.
